menu.CopyFailed: Could not copy the selected text.
menu.SelectionChanged: The note or selection context changed. Select the text and open the menu again.
menu.NativeQueryUnavailable: Native search opened, but the selected text could not be filled in automatically.

search.SelectionRequired: Select searchable text in this note before enabling Find in selection. Wait for reading view to finish rendering, if needed.
search.WorkerCompatibility: Worker unavailable. Using synchronous compatibility mode; complex regular expressions may block the interface.
search.WorkerFailed: Search execution failed. Retry in a Worker, or explicitly retry synchronously (complex regex may block the interface).
search.MatchPending: Searching… Close or cancel to stop the Worker.
search.ReplacementPending: Preparing replacement… No edit has been applied yet; close or cancel to stop.
search.ReplacementRematching: Replacement applied. Updating matches… Cancelling will not undo the edit.
search.ReadingPendingDetail: Waiting for reading text to finish rendering.
search.EditorFailed: Could not update the editor position or mode. Try again after the view is ready.
search.ReplacedNavigationFailed: Replacement was applied, but positioning failed. Check the text before replacing again.
search.ReplacementModified: The host only partially applied or modified the replacement. Check the text before replacing again; it will not be replayed automatically.
search.ReplacementReadOnly: This editor is read-only. No replacement was applied. Make the note editable before replacing again.
search.ReplacementRejected: The editor refused the replacement. No edit was applied. Check the note and editor state before replacing again.
search.ReadingFailed: Reading search or navigation failed. Retry, or enable native find in settings.
search.ReadingTimeout: Reading render timed out. Retry, or use native find.
search.ReadingUnsupported: This reading renderer or system does not support plugin search. Use native find or switch to editing mode.

tip.MoveFinder: Drag to move finder; arrow keys move, Home restores position
tip.FindInSelectionUnavailable: Find in selection (selection unavailable; select again and run Open find in selection, or turn off the scope)

ShowFindAndReplace.name: Open search & replace in current file

HistoryRetention.name: When history is full, keep
HistoryRetention.desc: Independent of display order. Upgrades retain the previous eviction preference. Presets are never evicted.

Toolbar.defaultsDesc: Default options apply when a finder is first created for a Markdown view. Reopening, switching files or changing modes keeps your manual choices; existing finders are not changed.

ClearAfterHidden.name: Clear search and replacement text
ClearAfterHidden.desc: Clear the search and replacement text when closing the finder. Match options are retained.

FinderDockSide.name: Finder collapse edge
FinderDockSide.desc: Collapse the finder to this edge of its note view. Search and highlights remain active; expanding the tab does not open the keyboard.

FinderAutoDock.name: Collapse when dragged to an edge
FinderAutoDock.desc: Drag the move control near either edge and release. For near-full-width panels, drag clearly left or right; vertical movement does not collapse the finder. Replacement progress stays expanded.

ShowFloatingFinderOnOpen.name: Show floating search entry when opening notes
ShowFloatingFinderOnOpen.desc: Show a compact search icon when opening Markdown notes, without searching or taking focus. Click to expand or drag to move; enabling this also applies to notes already open.

EnableInputHotkeys.name: Enable input box hotkey
EnableInputHotkeys.desc: Press Enter in the search box to jump to the next match, or in the replace box to replace once.

SourceModeWhenSearch.name: Force source code mode during search
SourceModeWhenSearch.desc: Use source mode while searching, so content that cannot be shown directly in Live Preview can still be located.

MoveCursorToMatch.name: Move the cursor to the matching item
MoveCursorToMatch.desc: Move the cursor and select the current match when searching.

UseSelectionAsSearch.name: Use selected text as search text
UseSelectionAsSearch.desc: Use the currently selected text as the query when opening Find.

UseEscapeCharInReplace.name: Support escape characters in replacement input box
UseEscapeCharInReplace.desc: In regex mode, the replacement box supports \n and \t for a line feed and a tab.

EnableHistory.name: Enable Search History
EnableHistory.desc: Record exact queries and usage, and navigate history with Up/Down. Disabling keeps existing history but stops recording and usage statistics.

HistoryMaxCount.name: Max History Count
HistoryMaxCount.desc: 1–200 items. Confirm with Enter or by leaving the field. Lowering the limit trims history using the retention policy; presets are unaffected.

HistorySortOrder.name: History Sort Order
HistorySortOrder.desc: Choose the sort order for history list

library.DuplicateName: A preset with this name already exists. Choose a different name.
library.LegacyDuplicateNames: Some saved presets share a name. Their configurations are preserved; rename them to use unique names.
library.UndoNameConflict: Cannot restore this preset: its name or identity is already in use. Existing presets were not changed.
library.CollapseOnApplyHint: Only hides the replacement input; keeps its contents.
library.ReplacementNotSaved: Fills find options only. Replacement text stays in the draft, not the saved preset.
library.FoldedReplacement: Replacement is saved; its row will stay folded when applied.
library.DragHelp: Drag to reorder, or use Up/Down, Home/End on the handle. Escape cancels a drag.
library.FilteredOrder: Clear the filter to reorder presets.
library.Title: History and presets
library.Name: Name
library.EmptyReplacement: Also fills replacement text; leave it empty to delete matches.
library.ApplyHint: Applying fills the finder and searches. It never replaces text automatically.
library.ReadingHint: Reading view applies find options only. Replacement requires editing view.
library.HistoryHint: History restores query text only. Copying does not change usage statistics.
library.SaveHint: Saves configuration only; does not edit the note.
library.EmptyPresets: No presets yet. Save your current find, or create a named rule.
library.NoResults: No matching entries. Try a different filter.
library.SaveConflict: This preset was changed or deleted elsewhere. Choose Save as preset to keep your draft without overwriting it.
library.Unsaved: This preset has unsaved changes. Discard them?

history.Title: Search History
history.LoadFailed: Text Finder could not read saved settings. Saving is blocked to protect existing data. Check the data file and reload the plugin.
history.SaveFailed: Text Finder could not save settings/history. Changes remain in memory; the next change will retry saving the latest state.
history.SubscriberFailed: Text Finder could not refresh one view. Other views and saving continue. Reopen the affected view.
history.CopyFailed: Text Finder could not copy the query text.
history.ReuseFailed: Open a supported Markdown editing or reading view before reusing search history.
